html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 10, 2022

On May 6, 2022, big-data analytics & MarTech vendor Sensors Data (神策数据) (founded 2015) closed a $200M Series D co-led by Tiger Global and Carlyle, with Mingshi, DCM, Linear, Sequoia China, Warburg Pincus, Bessemer, M31, Xianghe, 5Y Capital, GGV following — for MarTech full-funnel data connectivity, strategy engines, and industry extensibility. “Two clouds + one platform”: Analytics Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Foundation. 2,000+ logos across 30+ verticals; renewal >100%; >100k active users.

— END —
